g.text: The admission decision: C3's fixed order in the admitting commit, then C4's re-check in the fused start commit
(the first check that fails answers, so the same inputs and store always give the same answer)
or Send (the owner, with a client request id)
Admission commit (one pi-durable commit, C1, C3)
owner Send with a client request id already seen?
1. the wallet exists, not archived, not being removed?
Idle · call [wallet_usable and payer == 'owner' and not fits] → Refused
owner authority (law 1): no rule applies; FIFO with the agents (C2)
2. the agent is on for this wallet (among its own wallets only)?
3. the wallet tool is on: tool in effect, definition version, account generation (allowedAs)?
4. the arguments parse: decimal string, listed token, positive, within decimals?
5x. an observation of this chat, verified TLS, https, unexpired, unpaid;
v2, scheme exact, wallet's network, pinned asset and domain,
identity = (wallet, agent, origin and path, payTo, asset, network)
5. canonical identity: EIP-55 on the wallet's network; not zero, the token,
the wallet itself or a precompile?
Refused (contract and look-alike flags go on the card)
6. the wallet can sign now: lease held, keychain usable, not host mode,
chain id matches, no code at the address, lane not blocked, parked or frozen?
7. the rule, by identity, never by label (C18)
Refused: "the owner doesn't pay <name>", no Wait
rule Ask, or unknown with the default Ask?
Refused: "this agent only pays the recipients the owner set up"
Idle · call [... eff != 'deny' and not fits] → Refused
Refused, with the available amount, no draft (OD-8, C11)
8. available = balance at block b − reservations − fee reserves ≥ amount?
Refused: an ask is already open
9. one open ask per (wallet, agent, recipient, amount, asset); at most 5 per agent?
Idle · call [... eff == 'ask' and fits] → Waiting
Waiting: the card, deadline 24 h, reservation
9. burst: more than 10 payments in an hour to this Always recipient?
the system drops the rule to Ask (versioned act, C8)
recipient always · burst_pause [version_current and not other_agents_always] → ask
Idle · call [... eff == 'always' and fits] → Queued
Queued in the wallet's lane, reservation
Fused start commit, when the lane reaches the payment (C4: the burn point)
The signer reads and proves the key and signs in its own memory
the payment is still Queued (no cancel, no Deny sweep)?
agent payer and eff is deny now?
Queued · start_commit [not ledger_moved and payer == 'agent' and eff == 'deny'] → Refused
start_ok: owner payer, or Always now, or an approval at most 1 h old?
fits the balance at the latest block?
Queued · start_commit [not ledger_moved and start_ok and fits] → Signed
synced before any broadcast (C5, C6, C21)
Broadcast the stored bytes; the lane owns the outcome from here (C13)
